preconditions.description: The length of string A must be between 1 and 5000.
The length of string B must be between 1 and 5000.
The lengths of strings A and B must match the provided integer lengths n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: String A must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: String B must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximal similarity score as a string.
The maximal similarity score must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: maximal_score == max(4 * lcs_length - len(C) - len(D) for C in substrings(A) for D in substrings(B))
postconditions.description: The maximal similarity score must be calculated correctly for all possible substrings C of A and D of B.
